verdict.rationale: Appwrite's CLI explicitly supports non-interactive/headless automation ('used in a non-interactive and headless manner... especially useful when you want to automate tasks on a continuous integration server') and can create/manage projects, resources, users, functions, and deploy via scriptable commands, plus JSON-based config splitting via `includes`. Auth setup, database/schema, and permissions are all documented as manageable through the CLI/API, and the MCP server lets agents drive these operations too. Missing for 10: a single documented end-to-end example script showing an agent provisioning schema+auth+policies together in one headless run, and independent/hands-on verification of this exact workflow.
